description: This file defines the `Git::SVN::GlobSpec` package which provides functionality for parsing and handling glob patterns related to file paths, including pattern validation and path construction.

classes.name: Git::SVN::GlobSpec
classes.description: A class representing a glob pattern for file path matching, with methods for pattern parsing, validation, and path generation.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that parses a glob pattern string, validates it, and compiles matching regular expressions.

methods.name: full_path
methods.description: Constructs a full file path by combining the left segment, a given subpath, and the right segment based on the parsed glob pattern.
